newsitem.title: USA: PageNet happy with VoiceNow test so far.
newsitem.headline: PageNet happy with VoiceNow test so far.

text.p: Paging Network Inc said on Monday that it was satisfied with the progress of its beta tests for VoiceNow, its voice messaging product which it hopes to launch commercially by the end of the year.
"Marketing feedback so far is very good. We are very excited about this product," a spokeswoman said.

PageNet is conductiong technical, marketing and distribution tests for the product in San Francisco and Dallas. Once testing is concluded the product will be rolled out throughout the country, she said.
VoiceNow uses Motorola Inc's InFLEXion voice messaging protocol, carried over PageNet's narrowband personal communications services (PCS) licenses which it bought in a federal auction in 1994.
